assets.title: Meadow Stacked Beehive
assets.description: Original raised timber beehive with stacked supers, pitched weatherproof lid, flight board, recessed entrance and four legs. Closed exterior prop.

assets.title: Handcrafted Porch Cottage
assets.description: S03 handcrafted porch cottage with masonry base, timber bearing structure, plaster walls, recessed door and glazing, staggered thick clay roof tiles and ridge caps. Dimensions and porch/opening interfaces differ from village-cottage-01; not a drop-in replacement. Static architectural asset with fixed door and glazing; independently reviewed under art-v2. No operable-door or enterable-interior functionality is included.

assets.title: Meadow Farm Workyard
assets.description: Original farm workyard combining a supported firewood storage bay, a thick-walled water trough and three approach stones on a meadow slab. Standalone generator with complete verified support graph.

assets.title: Meadow Right-Angle Fence
assets.description: Original right-angle timber corner with a shared central post and two one-metre fence wings. Corner origin is the central post foot; endpoints at (1,0) and (0,1).

assets.title: Meadow Hinged Gate
assets.description: Original two-metre gateway with hinged timber gate, diagonal sag brace and visible iron latch. End posts at x=-1 and +1 metres match the field fence grid.

assets.title: Meadow Two-Metre Fence
assets.description: Original timber field fence with pointed posts, two rails and staggered pickets. Snaps at post centres x=-1 and +1 metres; GLB is a joined mesh: edit out one duplicate terminal post for each joint; simple 2m instancing overlaps terminal posts.

assets.title: Meadow Porch Planter
assets.description: Original raised plank flower box with contrasting corner feet, inset soil and three low-poly flowering plants.

assets.title: Meadow Arched Footbridge
assets.description: Original short pedestrian footbridge with shallow arched plank deck, segmented support stringers and handrails. Ground origin; approximately 2.6m span, one-metre deck.

assets.title: Meadow Harvest Handcart
assets.description: Original two-wheel harvest handcart with open plank bed, spoked timber wheels, metal tyres, handles and a standing support.

assets.title: Meadow Firewood Shelter
assets.description: Original open-front firewood shelter with sloped weather roof, supporting frame and six stacked round logs. Exterior utility prop with actual roof supports.

assets.title: Meadow Produce Stall
assets.description: Original open market stall with pitched striped timber canopy, front display counter and two divided produce trays. Walk-in access at rear.

assets.title: Meadow Village Noticeboard
assets.description: Original timber public noticeboard with three blank paper notices, fitted pegs and a weather cap. Static sign prop without text or external textures.

assets.title: Round Orchard Tree
assets.description: Original broadleaf orchard tree with forked trunk, three faceted crown masses and visible surface roots. Ground-centred placement.

assets.title: Meadow Picnic Table
assets.description: Original picnic table with two integrated slatted benches, longitudinal brace and eight grounded legs. All seat and tabletop supports are modeled.

assets.title: Meadow Stepping Path
assets.description: Original two-metre path module with irregular beveled paving stones and open grass gaps. Tile at 2 metre X intervals; ground-centre origin.

assets.title: Willow Stone Well
assets.description: Original hollow coursed-stone village well with pitched timber canopy, spindle, crank and suspended bucket.

assets.title: Meadow Kitchen Garden Bed
assets.description: Original raised vegetable plot with joined timber frame, supported soil and six leafy carrot plants. Compact editable garden prop.

assets.title: Meadow Stone Water Trough
assets.description: Original open monolithic stone livestock trough with thick walls, recessed water and two low feet. Basin is one closed manifold wall-and-floor mesh.

assets.title: Meadow Well Courtyard
assets.description: Original compact village vignette combining a hollow stone well, orchard tree, timber fence, stepping approach and meadow shrubs on a five-metre base. Reproducible standalone generator; editable component objects.

assets.title: Meadow Anvil on Stump
assets.description: Original village smith anvil with tapered horn, heel, modeled waist and foot mounted on a grounded timber stump with two iron bindings. Static unrigged prop.

assets.title: Meadow Direction Sign
assets.description: Original triple-arrow timber wayfinding post with three blank boards and visible iron fixings. Meter-scale static village prop.

assets.title: Meadow Gathering Corner
assets.description: Original compact village meeting scene with a picnic table, public noticeboard and rounded grass base. Separate editable source parts and a single self-contained export.

assets.title: Meadow Hand Water Pump
assets.description: Original cast-metal manual village water pump with modeled lever, axle, wooden grip and downturned spout. Static unrigged prop.

assets.title: Meadow Low Masonry Wall Module
assets.description: Original 2.04 meter wide low stone wall module with four lower ashlar blocks, three staggered upper blocks, continuous footing and fitted coping.

assets.title: Meadow Nursery Corner
assets.description: Original village nursery scene with three planted wooden trays and a two-tier timber stand on stone paving. The upper and lower trays are supported on shelves; the ready-to-plant tray rests on the paving.

assets.title: Meadow Two-Tier Nursery Rack
assets.description: Original freestanding two-tier timber nursery rack with four grounded legs, two plant shelves and an inset back rail. Sized to support the matching seedling trays.

assets.title: Meadow Seedling Tray
assets.description: Original small wooden seed tray containing six modeled seedlings, soil, inset end boards and a solid bottom. Each leaf connects to a stem and soil-supported root.

assets.title: Meadow Smith Work Corner
assets.description: Original compact village workshop scene featuring an anvil on timber stump, three-tool hanging rack and a low trestle carrying metal stock on stone paving.

assets.title: Meadow Raised Stone Lookout
assets.description: Original raised village stoop demonstration combining four stone steps, an independently supported landing and a low masonry parapet on a meadow base. Separate blocks intentionally retain small installation seams.

assets.title: Meadow Four-Step Stone Module
assets.description: Original four-tier stone stair module ascending along positive Y, with slightly inset successive tiers and a 0.69 meter top tread. Each tier is modeled and structurally supported.

assets.title: Meadow Workshop Tool Rack
assets.description: Original freestanding timber tool rack with iron pins, hammer, wooden mallet and chisel. Each handle and tool head has modeled structural support.

assets.title: Meadow Village Water Point
assets.description: Original public water-point scene combining a hand pump, triple-arrow wayfinding post and recessed stone drain with iron grate on a cobbled plinth.

assets.title: Timber and Plaster Solid Wall, 2 m
assets.description: Independent S03 modular village wall: 2 m repeat, 2.6 m height, 0.22 m plaster core and two-sided timber details. Matching X-end plaster profiles with 2 mm top-rail installation seam. Central stud has a deliberate 10 mm face offset from the lower rail; short junction shadows are geometric rebates. Cottage v2 supplies the appearance reference, not a directly interchangeable building system. Static visual module; no structural, collision or navigation claims.

assets.title: Open Doorway Wall, 2 m
assets.description: Independent S03 modular village wall: 2 m repeat, 2.6 m height, 0.22 m plaster core and two-sided timber details. Matching X-end plaster profiles with 2 mm top-rail installation seam. Real open doorway, 0.98 m clear width and 2.05 m clear height measured above the 0.08 m threshold, with no door leaf. Cottage v2 supplies the appearance reference, not a directly interchangeable building system. Static visual module; no structural, collision or navigation claims.

assets.title: L-Corner Timber Wall, 2 m Interfaces
assets.description: Independent S03 L-corner wall with a continuous L-shaped plaster body and one owned corner post. Actual outer bounds are 2.14 by 2.14 by 2.60 m; matching terminal planes are X=2 m and Y=2 m, measured from the ground-level corner grid origin. Straight wall companions mount at (3,0,0) and (0,3,0), with the latter rotated 90 degrees. No doubled corner columns or nonuniform scaling required. Warm timber and pale plaster follow the S03 family. Cottage v2 is an appearance reference, not an interchangeable source. Static visual architecture;

assets.title: Deep Window Wall, 2 m
assets.description: Independent S03 2 m wall with a true 0.98 by 1.00 m framed window opening; sill top at local Z=1.00 m, recessed reveal and projecting stone sill. Matching straight-wall end profile and 2 mm combined timber seam. No glass or shutter included. Warm timber and pale plaster follow the S03 family. Cottage v2 is an appearance reference, not an interchangeable source. Static visual architecture;

assets.title: Clay Roof Section — 2m Repeat
assets.description: S03 modular clay gable-roof section with three restrained staggered courses per slope. Four-metre wall-centre span, two-metre Y repeat, explicit wall-cap mounting plane at local Z=0. Real opposite-face rafter/deck and ridge contacts with no forced interpenetration. Actual wall-cap and repeat-end contacts are recorded in local assembly evidence. Mounting origin is at wall-cap level; no terrain placement, structural load-capacity or runtime collision guarantee.

assets.title: Gable End — 4m Span
assets.description: S03 modular gable end with wall-cap base and a quarter-metre terminal clay roof strip meeting the repeating roof at local Y=0. Four-metre wall-centre span, quarter-metre outward terminal strip, explicit wall-cap mounting plane at local Z=0. Real opposite-face rafter/deck and ridge contacts with no forced interpenetration. Actual end-wall cap and repeating-roof mating evidence is retained for this visual module. No structural load-capacity or runtime collision guarantee.

assets.title: Stone Foundation — 2m Tile
assets.description: S03 modular stone foundation tile with a shallow inset lower course. Two-metre X/Y repeat and 0.30m flat full top for separately assembled wall modules. Real flat lower ground surface and positive opposite-face upper-course contacts. Visual game module, not a load-capacity or terrain-conformance guarantee.

assets.title: Timber Floor Kit — Five Fitting Profiles
assets.description: One S03 timber floor family supplied as five separately named mesh nodes with bottom-centre origins: Centre 2x2m, End 2x1.858m, Edge .858x2m, EdgeEnd .858x1.858m, and DoorEdge .858x2m with a 20mm threshold recess. Select a node and replace its display translation with its installation position; the spaced 4.5m display layout is not one floor tile. Finished panel height .08m matches the .38m doorway threshold when mounted on .30m stone foundations. True cut board widths retain the board pitch; variants are not five new asset types. See generate.py opening documentation for complete node selection, dimensions, coordinate conventions and unit-scale 4x8m shell coverage. Visual geometry only, no collision, accessibility or load guarantee.

assets.title: Low Timber Entry Landing
assets.description: Original S03 low timber entry landing, 2m wide by 1m deep. Five boards bear on two beams and four short ground blocks; finished surface .30m matches the existing stone apron, with a declared .08m rise to the doorway sill. The old .69m four-tier stair is not fitted or rescaled. Visual modular entrance platform, no navigation or accessibility guarantee.

assets.title: Low Two-Rise Stone Entrance Steps
assets.description: S03 continuous low stone stair: 1.20m wide, .60m deep, two .15m rises and .30m treads. Local +X rises toward a .30m landing, with a separate .08m doorway threshold rise unchanged. Actual closed profile, not a rescaled legacy stair. Visual interface only, no navigation, load or accessibility certification.

assets.title: Single-Slope Timber Entrance Canopy
assets.description: S03 four-post single-slope entrance canopy, mounted on the common .30m landing/apron top plane. Cut post heads and two sloping rails support the roof with six broad staggered clay groups. Covers the landing-to-door approach while remaining separate from the main eave. See generate.py opening documentation for exact host locations and installation axes. Visual geometry only; no load, accessibility or navigation certification.

assets.title: Fitted Timber Door Leaf
assets.description: S03 five-board fitted door for the .98x2.05m clear doorway in village-doorway-wall-2m-01. Mount at the host local origin with unit scale. HingeMounts_Static stays fixed; DoorLeaf_Runtime has the real hinge pivot(-.51,-.20,.08)m and editable local Z rotation. Seven discrete poses from0 to-90degrees in15degree steps checked; real polygon pin clearance and bearing support. No continuous motion, hardware simulation or accessibility guarantee.

assets.title: Paired Timber Window Shutters
assets.description: S03 paired three-board shutters for the .98x1m clear window in village-window-wall-2m-01. Mount at the host local origin with unit scale. HingeMounts_Static stays fixed. LeftShutter_Runtime/RightShutter_Runtime use real pivots(-.51,-.21,1)/(+.51,-.21,1)m. Nineteen discrete paired and single-leaf poses to90degrees checked, with real polygon pin clearance and bearing support. No continuous motion or hardware simulation guarantee.

assets.title: Two-Metre Soil Road Straight
assets.description: S03 continuous closed soil-road module with restrained earth and grass-shoulder zones. Nominal 2 m square, centre top .06 m, shallow rut bottoms .052 m, shoulders .02 m; matching actual end profiles, tested 2 mm installation seams. Use at unit scale; select appropriate straight or T routing. Approach to the separate .15 m first stair retains about 90–98 mm rise, then .30 m landing and .38 m doorway threshold. No navigation, accessibility or structural certification.

assets.title: Two-Metre Soil Road T Junction
assets.description: S03 continuous closed soil-road module with restrained earth and grass-shoulder zones. Nominal 2 m square, centre top .06 m, shallow rut bottoms .052 m, shoulders .02 m; matching actual end profiles, tested 2 mm installation seams. Use at unit scale; select appropriate straight or T routing. Approach to the separate .15 m first stair retains about 90–98 mm rise, then .30 m landing and .38 m doorway threshold. No navigation, accessibility or structural certification.

assets.title: Quarter-Turn Village Soil Road
assets.description: S03 compact quarter-turn soil path for village lanes and pedestrian environment layouts. One closed faceted quarter-sector with shared 2 m top-section ports, 1 m centreline radius, 2 m outer radius and restrained soil/grass shoulders. Place at unit scale; tested 2 mm installation gaps. No vehicle steering, navigation or accessibility guarantee.

assets.title: Rising Village Soil Road
assets.description: S03 closed earth road grade, 2 m long and 2 m wide with 0.5 m rise, maximum height 0.56 m. One continuous ground-supported embankment carries restrained soil and grass shoulders. Both top cross-sections match the 2 m flat-road family after the high end is raised 0.5 m. A high flat neighbour requires separate terrain support; demonstration support terrain is not included. Use unit scale and tested 2 mm seams. No navigation, accessibility, vehicle or engineering guarantee.

assets.title: Village Public Paving Kit
assets.description: S03 public paving family with two selectable unit-scale nodes: Paving_Core_2x2 (2 x 2 m) and Paving_Entry_0p5x2 (0.5 x 2 m). Each has a local bottom-centre origin; default separated translations are a selection layout, not one installed tile. See the opening documentation in generate.py for dimensions, node selection and the validated installation table. Real shallow stone-joint relief and a soil-road-profile entrance. One kit, without navigation, accessibility or engineering guarantees.

assets.title: Village Narrow Stone Border Kit
assets.description: S03 narrow planting-side stone boundary family with two selectable bottom-centre nodes: a 2 x 0.16 x 0.12 m straight and a 0.16 m clipped external corner. Unit-scale defaults are a separated selection layout. Full node selection, orientation and actual 2 mm interface installation table are in the opening documentation of generate.py. Boundary rises 60 mm above the matching public paving; keep entrances open. One family, without engineering or accessibility guarantees.

assets.title: Village Stone Box Culvert 2m
assets.description: S03 raised soil-road module with a small true stone-slab through channel. A 2 m road footprint matches existing rising-road high ends, with seven editable closed source parts and one static runtime mesh. Clear opening 0.34 x 0.24 m; its actual stone bottom is 0.06 m above the mounting plane. Overall depth includes 60 mm lining projections at both ends. See generate.py opening documentation for exact profile and placement. No water, navigation or structural performance guarantee.

assets.title: Independent Draped Cloth Awning
assets.description: Independent S03 draped cloth shelter with a continuous thick broad-fold canvas, four square posts and two real seating bars. Seven editable closed source parts export as one static runtime mesh. Overall 2.4 x 1.68 x 2.462 m. See generate.py opening documentation for origin, optional paving layout and finite geometric checks. Paving and reference figure are not included; no fabric simulation, load or weather guarantee

assets.title: Tied Harvest Grain Sheaf
assets.description: Static S03 tied grain sheaf with nine gathered cut stems, elongated overlapping seed heads and a small rope binding knot. Three solid PBR materials,86 editable closed source pieces and one assembled runtime mesh. See generate.py opening documentation for origin, unit-scale placement and finite geometric validation scope. Paving and shelter are not included; no crop species, rope simulation or balance guarantee

assets.title: Open Coarse-Band Harvest Basket
assets.description: Open S03 coarse-band harvest basket with a continuous thick cavity, a real flat bottom and two open end handles. Three broad horizontal bands and six wide upright paths are modeled relief; two natural-fibre PBR values follow full bands. Three editable closed source parts export as one static runtime mesh. See generate.py opening documentation for dimensions, origin and verified optional placement. No carrying-load or woven-material simulation guarantee

assets.title: Open Spill-Channel Water Receiver
assets.description: Open D-shaped warm-grey earthenware receiver with a genuine high side overflow opening and a short outward U-section spill channel. Two closed editable source parts export as one static runtime mesh. See generate.py opening documentation for dimensions, the 2 mm downward spill-floor step and optional freestanding placement. No upstream gutter, liquid simulation or watertightness guarantee
